title: Linearization of the image of nil units modulo a smaller ideal
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $I,J$ be quasi-coherent ideal sheaves [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers] such that $J\subseteq I$, $I^2\subseteq J$, and $I\subseteq\mathcal N_X$, the nilradical [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. For an ideal $K$, let $i_K:Z_K\to X$ be its specified closed subscheme immersion, and let $q_K:\mathbf G_{m,X}\to(i_K)_*\mathbf G_{m,Z_K}$ be restriction of units [def-sc-gm-torsor]. Let $I_{\rm mod}$ and $J_{\rm mod}$ denote the specified ideal modules, defined as kernels of restriction of the structure module to the closed subschemes, and let $F=\operatorname{coker}(J_{\rm mod}\to I_{\rm mod})$ using the specified inclusion. Assume $F$ is quasi-coherent. There is an isomorphism of abelian sheaves on $X_{\rm et}$ between $\operatorname{im}(\ker(q_I)\to\mathbf G_{m,X}\xrightarrow{q_J}(i_J)_*\mathbf G_{m,Z_J})$ and $\operatorname{ULift}(F_{\rm et})$, where $F_{\rm et}$ is the tensor-sections sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module]. All kernels, images and cokernels are categorical constructions.

Compose the two isomorphisms through the concrete additive image sheaf. Their intermediate objects are definitionally equal, and the composite has precisely the original source and target.

mathlib_searches.query: The image of units congruent to one modulo a nil ideal I in units modulo J, where I squared is contained in J, is the additive etale sheaf of I modulo J
For nil ideals J contained in I with I squared contained in J, the image of units 1+I in units modulo J is the additive etale sheaf I/J
